reason: D4 applies: the table page cannot open from a batch item's source for a CSV of 16 MiB or less or for any XLSX without a server change.

findings.what: A CSV or XLSX dropped into the batch is kept through /uploads as profile large-original-v1 (viaUpload is true for every name other than .geojson/.json/.zip).
The table page shows 'This retained source is not a table.' unless the source's profile is manual-tabular/1; a batch item's large-original-v1 source has none until it is read as a table.
The only route that turns an already kept original into a table refuses originals of 16 MiB or less (TABLE_ORIGINAL_SMALL) and reads only CSV (TABULAR_FORMAT refuses XLSX).

Without the server change the Studio's only options are a second copy of the bytes through POST /sources (a different source, and only while the File is still in the drop dialog) or a sheet question before retention for XLSX; both contradict D2 ('for that source', 'joins the batch as an item').

No blocker for D1 and D3: a small ZIP goes to POST intake/archives and a GPKG or large ZIP to /uploads; the batch converts a GeoPackage or a ZIP whose card names a shapefile set (SH2), and the archive route accepts any ZIP up to 16 MiB.
Large CSV (above 16 MiB) works today from a batch item: tableFromOriginal(caseId, sourceId, { requestKey, expectedWorkspaceRevision, selection: csv }) then the table page.

serverChangeNeeded.change: For a large-original-v1 source of 16 MiB or less, read the object whole and profile it with the same bounded tabular reader the /sources table route uses (inspectTabularSource with the request's selection), for CSV and for XLSX (sheet and header rows from the selection); keep the streamed CSV path above 16 MiB; refuse XLSX above 16 MiB with its own words. Same pins, replay key, revision check and source.retained event as today.
serverChangeNeeded.studioAfter: Batch item of family table: 'Read as a table' -> CSV posts tableFromOriginal with the fixed CSV selection and opens /studio/work/cases/{caseId}/tables/{sourceId}; XLSX first asks sheet and header rows on that page (TableSelectionFields), no case choice. Then file-route.ts sends .gpkg, every ZIP, CSV and XLSX to the batch and the drop list words each route.

alternativeWithoutServerChange: CSV only: retain a CSV of 16 MiB or less through POST /sources (format csv, fixed selection) and enrol it with /intake/items (intake-context.ts:55 accepts tabular-manual-v1), so its item's source is already a table. Needs retain-batch.ts (not in N01's owned paths) and leaves XLSX unsolved.
